scripts.dev:bare: npm run build -w @fleet/protocol && concurrently -P -n host,node "npm run host" "npm run node -- {@}" --
scripts.dev:tunnel:bare: npm run build -w @fleet/protocol && concurrently -P -n tunnel,host,node "npm run tunnel" "npm run host" "npm run node -- {@}" --
scripts.host:fresh: npm run build -w @fleet/protocol && npm run build -w @fleet/host && npm run start:host -- --reset-auth
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fleet/protocol && npm run build -w @fleet/host && npm run build -w @fleet/node
scripts.build:node: npm run build -w @fleet/protocol && npm run build -w @fleet/node
scripts.start:bare: concurrently -P -n host,node "npm run start:host" "npm run start:node -- {@}" --
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fleet/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @fleet/host && npm run typecheck -w @fleet/node && npm run typecheck -w @fleet/protocol
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
